metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · Insidious: Out of the Further
metas.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · The End of Oak Street
metas.description: The Platt family bands together to navigate their new surroundings after a cosmic event transports their suburban neighborhood to someplace unknown.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · The Last House
metas.description: A family of four is suddenly sealed inside their house with no way out and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · Disclosure Day
metas.description: If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you?

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · Scream 7

metas.name: ★ 4.0 · 2026 · Return to Silent Hill

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · The Housemaid

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · The Woman in Cabin 10

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2025 · The Conjuring: Last Rites

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2025 · Highest 2 Lowest

metas.name: ★ 5.3 · 2025 · Honey Don't!

metas.description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2025 · Heart Eyes
